title: TONGUE SCANS, AI GAMING, & KILL SWITCHES: Matt & Jimmy debate their favourite AI stories from August 2024
description: Send us Fan Mail Ever wondered how AI is revolutionizing the gaming world? Discover the cutting-edge innovations that are reshaping video games, from AI-generated characters and narratives to groundbreaking technologies like text-to-speech. We'll explore the fascinating mod for Skyrim that breathes new life into in-game interactions through large language models. Get ready to see how the future of gaming may evolve with these technological marvels and whether AI will complement or compete with virtual reality advancements. Imagine a world where AI can create entire games autonomously. We delve into Google's remarkable achievement of crafting an AI-generated version of Doom, envisioning future possibilities and the societal impact of AI companions. Additionally, we'll compare Western and Chinese large language models, revealing unique differences in censorship and creativity, and examining models like Alibaba's Tongyi and its innovative approach to generating song lyrics and other content. Lastly, we tackle the critical subjects of AI regulation and cybersecurity. Learn about California's impending legislation that mandates independent audits for AI models and explore the pressing need for robust governance. The episode also uncovers the intriguing concept of prompt injections in large language models, alongside a discussion on AI's role in healthcare, highlighted by an AI tongue scanner rooted in traditional Chinese medicine. Join us for a comprehensive and thought-provoking journey through the past, present, and future landscapes of AI.
summary: Jimmy and Matt debate their favourite August stories: Nvidia's AI-driven game characters and a fully AI-generated Doom, Chinese LLMs and their beatable guardrails, California's SB-1047 frontier-model bill with its kill-switch provisions, TCM tongue-scan AI hitting 96-98% diagnostic accuracy, prompt injection attacks, and the dystopian edge of AI seatbelt cameras.
keyTalkingPoints: Nvidia's ACE tech lets game NPCs converse instead of delivering one-liners — once on-device AI chips are common, the latency barrier disappears
Chinese models like Tongyi refuse whole categories of questions (even 1988+1) but collapse to simple jailbreaks like pretending it is a quiz
SB-1047 would make frontier-model developers financially liable for harms and mandate kill-switch capability — Matt calls it a potential template for national US law
AI tongue-scan research in China reported 96-98% accuracy in predicting certain illnesses, blending traditional Chinese medicine with machine learning
Prompt injection attacks and universal jailbreaks like Pliny's show guardrails are thin — even Claude was fully jailbroken on air weeks earlier

jimmy: On-device AI chips are the unlock for ambient AI in games and everyday software
VR will tick along until lightweight shades arrive, at which point it will take off
Superintelligence, if it comes, will hide its intentions until it can act — and LLM plateauing suggests current architecture will not produce it
AI seatbelt cameras are as dystopian as Chinese surveillance equivalents — two sides of the same coin
matt: SB-1047 is potentially one of the most important pieces of AI legislation — a precursor to national US rules holding developers accountable
AI's most positive use is preventive, holistic healthcare rather than treatment — though big pharma capture is the danger
China's TCM tongue-scan results are a genuinely promising medical AI application
Developers should assume jailbreaks already happen and build security accordingly
